title: Discovering the Future of Healthcare
excerpt: Join Anna Maria and Brian Clement as they explore the future of healthcare with Dr. Bissell, a pioneer in merging alternative and conventional medicine. Broadcasting from Hippocrates Health Institute, this episode delves into Dr. Bissell's journey from Switzerland to Scottsdale, shedding light on groundbreaking integrative cancer treatments that focus on the root causes of illness. Hear inspiring recovery stories and learn about the power of nurturing the mind and body for true healing.
